description: Price a part in EUR across economy, standard and express production, using the same engine as the public calculator. Supply surface_area_mm2 for a single price; omit it and the answer is the range the shape could produce. Excludes shipping and VAT.

bounding_box_mm.description: Overall size of the part in millimetres.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example "DE". Adds a courier transit estimate.

material_id.description: Material id from list_materials, for example "pla" or "abs".

surface_area_mm2.description: Outer surface area in mm2. Optional, but it is what turns the answer from a range into a single price. Call analyze_model to obtain it.

volume_cm3.description: Solid volume of the mesh in cm3. Not the bounding box volume.

name: estimate_price
title: Estimate a print price
